main.description: Enumerate every catalog edition in at-uri order, one page at a time. Anonymous and read-only, served by the bibliograph edge from `editions` alone: no identifiers, no contributors, no covers, and no PDS. Built for a crawler that needs the whole corpus (a sitemap, a mirror), which the search surface cannot serve because a search needs a term.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent when the catalogue is exhausted.

items.description: Editions in ascending at-uri order. Two pages never overlap, so a cursor walk over a growing catalogue revisits nothing.

indexedAt.description: When the catalog last indexed this edition. A sitemap's `lastmod` is this value.

uri.description: The edition's at-uri, in the authority the catalog currently publishes under.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. A malformed cursor restarts at the beginning rather than erroring.

limit.description: Maximum number of editions to return in this page. The default covers the whole catalogue in 283 requests; 5000 covers it in 57, each an index scan measured at ~180 ms. Requesting a larger page is the intended way to make a full crawl cheaper.
